properties.title: Luxury Downtown Apartment
properties.description: A stunning luxury apartment in the heart of the city. This property features floor-to-ceiling windows, premium finishes, and access to exclusive amenities including a rooftop pool, fitness center, and 24/7 concierge service.

interiors.name: Living room
interiors.detail: The living room runs 22 feet along a floor-to-ceiling glass wall facing Midtown. White oak floors continue in from the entry, and the ceiling is about 10 feet. A low sofa faces the glass, with a walnut coffee table and one lounge chair in the corner. A wide pass-through on the west wall opens into the kitchen, so the two rooms read as one.

interiors.name: Kitchen
interiors.detail: A galley kitchen, about 8 by 14 feet, with honed stone counters and flat-panel cabinets in a warm gray. The range, dishwasher, and refrigerator are panel-front. Upper cabinets stop short of the ceiling and leave a shelf for glassware. The pass-through is the main opening to the living room; a door at the far end reaches the service hall.

interiors.name: Primary bedroom
interiors.detail: The primary bedroom is at the east end of the apartment. A king bed faces the window, and blackout shades sit inside the frame. Closet doors run the full east wall, about 10 feet of hanging space and shelves. The ensuite bath opens at the foot of the bed. The floor is the same white oak as the living room.

interiors.name: Second bedroom
interiors.detail: The second bedroom is dressed as a guest room. A queen bed sits against the interior wall, and a desk fits under the window without covering the radiator. There is floor space for a crib that still leaves a path to the closet. The hall bath — a shower and a single vanity — is shared from this room.

interiors.name: Primary bath
interiors.detail: The primary bath is large-format stone tile. The walk-in shower has a fixed rain head and a handheld, with a niche for bottles cut into the wall. A double vanity holds two sinks and a bank of drawers under each. The hall bath, used by the guest bedroom, is a separate shower and a single vanity.

properties.title: Beachfront Villa
properties.description: Luxurious beachfront property with direct access to pristine white sand beaches. This villa offers panoramic ocean views, a private infinity pool, and meticulously landscaped gardens.

interiors.name: Great room
interiors.detail: The great room is one open volume from the entry to the pool sliders. Seating faces the ocean, not a television wall, and the sofa group sits on a rug that stops short of the slider track. The ceiling stays high enough that the terrace and the water stay in view from the kitchen island. Floors are wide-plank stone that continues onto the covered terrace.

interiors.name: Kitchen
interiors.detail: The kitchen is built around a white-stone island with seating for four on the great-room side. The range wall holds a cooktop and a tall fridge, and the pantry is a door behind that wall rather than open shelves. Counters are the same stone as the island. A second sink faces the pool so dishes can be passed outside without crossing the great room.

interiors.name: Primary suite
interiors.detail: The primary suite is on the ocean side, separated from the guest wing by a short hall. A sitting area with two chairs sits between the king bed and the balcony doors. The closet is a walk-in off the bath, not along the bedroom wall, so the ocean windows stay clear. Blackout drapes stack at the sides of the slider.

interiors.name: Guest bedroom
interiors.detail: This is one of four guest rooms on the garden side of the villa. Each has a queen bed, blackout drapes, a small desk, and a closet deep enough for hanging luggage. The bath is ensuite: a shower, a single vanity, and a door that does not open through the bedroom. The four rooms share a linen closet in the hall.

interiors.name: Primary bath
interiors.detail: The primary bath opens from the suite, not from the hall. A freestanding tub sits at the window, and the shower is a separate glass enclosure with a bench. The vanity is one long stone slab with two sinks and drawers between them. The walk-in closet is through a door beside the vanity.

properties.title: Modern Office Building
properties.description: Prime commercial real estate in the central business district. This modern office building features state-of-the-art facilities, energy-efficient design, and is fully leased to AAA-rated corporate tenants on long-term contracts.

interiors.name: Lobby
interiors.detail: The lobby is double-height, with a stone floor and a reception desk set off the entry so the elevator core stays visible. Visitor seating is a short run of chairs along the glass. Turnstiles sit between the desk and the elevators. The ceiling drops to a single story only at the mail room on the right.

interiors.name: Typical floor
interiors.detail: A typical floor is an open plate around a central core of elevators, stairs, and restrooms. Perimeter glass runs the full edge, with shades in the ceiling pocket. Columns land on a grid that can be demised into suites of about 2,500 sq ft without crossing the core. Raised floor is not used; power comes from the ceiling.

interiors.name: Conference center
interiors.detail: The second-floor conference center is shared by the building, not leased with a single floor. A boardroom seats about fourteen at one table. Two smaller huddle rooms open off the same pre-function hall, with a pantry counter between them. The hall has a coat closet and a door back to the elevator lobby.

properties.title: Mountain Retreat
properties.description: Secluded luxury cabin nestled in the mountains with breathtaking views. This property combines rustic charm with modern amenities, featuring exposed wooden beams, a stone fireplace, and a private hot tub.

interiors.name: Great room
interiors.detail: The great room sits under exposed timber beams. A stone fireplace is the center of the long wall, with seating pulled toward it and the glass that faces the slope. The floor is wide pine. A dining table for eight is at the kitchen end, still in the same volume, so the fireplace stays in view from the table.

interiors.name: Kitchen
interiors.detail: The kitchen is open to the great room, finished in warm wood cabinets and a stone counter. A farmhouse sink sits under the window that looks at the trees, not at the slope. The range is on the interior wall so the window stays clear. Open shelves above the counter hold everyday dishes; the pantry is a door beside the fridge.

interiors.name: Primary bedroom
interiors.detail: The primary bedroom is on the main level, off a short hall from the great room. A king bed faces the glass, with linen drapes on a wood rod. A door at the side of the room opens onto the hot-tub deck without passing back through the great room. The closet is a reach-in along the hall wall. The bath is ensuite.

interiors.name: Loft bedroom
interiors.detail: The loft bedroom sits under the roof pitch and is used as a bunk room: two sets of bunks and a chest at the stair. Headroom is full at the stair and lower at the eaves. Two more bedrooms are on the lower hall, each with a queen bed, a closet, and a window to the slope. They share a bath at the end of that hall.

properties.title: Urban Retail Space
properties.description: High-traffic retail location in a trendy urban neighborhood. This corner unit features large display windows, modern interior, and is surrounded by complementary businesses that drive consistent foot traffic.

interiors.name: Sales floor
interiors.detail: The sales floor is about 1,600 sq ft of open space. The path from the corner entrance runs straight to the back counter, with display tables on both sides rather than a maze of racks. The floor is polished concrete. Track lighting hangs on the ceiling grid. A fitting room is a single door on the left wall, not a bank of stalls.

interiors.name: Window display
interiors.detail: The corner has display windows on two streets. The sill is deep enough for a mannequin run and a low seating ledge inside the glass. Shades are a simple roller at the head of each window. The entry door is on the long side, so the corner itself stays a display, not a vestibule.

interiors.name: Back room
interiors.detail: The back room is storage and a small staff area, about 400 sq ft. Shelving runs one wall from floor to ceiling. A desk and a locker sit opposite. The alley door is at the rear, wide enough for a hand truck, with a step down to the pavement. A single restroom opens off this room, not off the sales floor.

properties.title: Historic Brownstone
properties.description: Beautifully restored historic brownstone in a prestigious neighborhood. This property combines classic architectural details with modern updates in one of the most sought-after locations.

interiors.name: Parlor
interiors.detail: The front parlor keeps the original mantel and the tall windows onto the street. Restored hardwood runs wall to wall, with a rug sized to the seating group and not to the whole room. The ceiling medallion and the window casings are intact. Pocket doors, when open, connect this room to the kitchen behind it.

interiors.name: Kitchen
interiors.detail: The kitchen is the updated room behind the parlor, still on the original brownstone plan rather than an open great room. A long counter runs one wall, with the range at the center and cabinets above and below. A door at the back opens to the garden. The floor is tile, a step down from the parlor hardwood.

interiors.name: Primary bedroom
interiors.detail: The primary bedroom is on the second floor, at the front of the house. Original trim frames two street-facing windows, and a king bed sits between them on the interior wall so both windows stay usable. The closet was built into a former dressing alcove and does not cut the windows. The bath is through a door at the back of the room.

interiors.name: Primary bath
interiors.detail: The primary bath was carved from a former dressing room, so it keeps the original window. A walk-in shower occupies the wall without the window. The vanity is a single sink with drawers, not a double, because the room is narrow. The floor is small hexagonal tile. A linen cupboard is the old closet, left in place.

interiors.name: Garden level
interiors.detail: The garden level is finished as a family room rather than raw basement. The ceiling is lower than the parlor, with the beams left exposed. A half bath is under the stair. A door at the back goes up a short run of steps to the rear garden. Two small bedrooms open off this level, each with a window at grade and a closet.

properties.title: Queen Anne House
properties.description: A restored Craftsman house on a quiet Queen Anne street, with a wide front porch, updated kitchen, and a backyard that faces west.

interiors.name: Porch
interiors.detail: The covered porch runs the width of the front elevation, with the original columns and a new cedar deck. The front door opens into a stair hall rather than straight into the living room.

interiors.name: Kitchen
interiors.detail: The kitchen was opened to the dining room but keeps the original window over the sink. Cabinets are painted wood, and the range sits on the interior wall so the window stays clear.

properties.title: Irvington Bungalow
properties.description: A 1924 bungalow with a deep front yard, a finished attic bedroom, and a kitchen that opens to a covered rear deck.

interiors.name: Living room
interiors.detail: The living room keeps the original fir floors and the built-in bookcases beside the fireplace. Windows face the front yard, and the ceiling is the original box-beam grid.

properties.title: LoHi Townhouse
properties.description: A three-level townhouse a short walk from the Highland shops, with a roof deck, a garage, and a main floor that is one open room.

interiors.name: Main floor
interiors.detail: The main floor is one room from the front door to the rear glass. The kitchen is along the party wall, and the dining table sits under the stair. The garage is a half level down.

properties.title: Gaslamp Condo
properties.description: A corner condo above the Gaslamp streets, with a balcony on two sides and a building gym on the second floor.

interiors.name: Living room
interiors.detail: The living room is the corner, with glass on two walls and a balcony door on the long side. The kitchen is a short galley behind a half wall, so the corner stays open.

properties.title: Gulch Apartment
properties.description: A one-bedroom apartment in a new Gulch building, leased to a single tenant, with a small balcony over the rail line.

interiors.name: Living room
interiors.detail: The living room and kitchen share one rectangle. A sofa faces the balcony door, and the kitchen is a single run of cabinets on the entry wall. The bedroom is through a door beside the bath.

properties.title: Desert Ridge Villa
properties.description: A single-level villa on a desert lot, with a courtyard pool, a casita, and a three-car garage. The main house is fully leased as a seasonal rental.

interiors.name: Courtyard
interiors.detail: The pool sits in a courtyard between the main house and the casita. Sliding doors from the great room open onto the water, and a covered dining loggia runs along one side.

properties.title: Tahoe Cabin
properties.description: A cedar cabin above the lake, still in pre-lease. The great room faces the slope, and two bedrooms sit under the eaves.

interiors.name: Great room
interiors.detail: The great room is one volume under a cedar ceiling. A wood stove sits on a stone hearth, and the deck door is centered on the slope wall. The kitchen is a short L at the entry end.

comps.address: 880 Pioneer Trail, South Lake Tahoe, CA

properties.title: Rainbow Row House
properties.description: A narrow historic house south of Broad, restored as a single residence with a private garden and a carriage house used as a studio.

interiors.name: Piazza
interiors.detail: The side piazza is the main outdoor room, screened on the garden side and open to the stair. The front room keeps its original mantel and faces the street.

properties.title: Dumbo Loft Apartment
properties.description: A loft apartment in a converted warehouse, with a sleeping mezzanine, concrete floors, and windows onto the East River.

interiors.name: Loft
interiors.detail: The main floor is one open room. The kitchen runs the windowless wall, and a steel stair rises to a mezzanine bedroom. The second bedroom is enclosed at the back, beside the bath.

properties.title: Garden District House
properties.description: A side-hall house under live oaks, with a front parlor, a rear garden, and a kitchen that was rebuilt without moving the original stair.

interiors.name: Parlor
interiors.detail: The front parlor is the formal room, with tall windows onto the square and the original mantel. The kitchen is behind it, a step down, and opens to the garden.

properties.title: Uptown Office
properties.description: A six-story office building north of downtown, leased to three tenants on staggered terms. The lobby and the elevator core were renovated in 2024.

interiors.name: Lobby
interiors.detail: The lobby is a single story with a stone floor and a reception desk set off the garage entry. Elevators sit at the back, and a small tenant lounge is to the right of the desk.

properties.title: Midtown Retail
properties.description: A street-level retail bay on a Midtown corner, with a full glass front, a stock room, and a lease to a single apparel tenant.

interiors.name: Sales floor
interiors.detail: The sales floor is open from the corner glass to a back counter. The stock room and a single restroom are behind that counter, with a service door to the alley.

properties.title: SoDo Commercial Warehouse
properties.description: A clear-span warehouse south of downtown with dock doors, a small office mezzanine, and a single industrial tenant on a five-year lease.

interiors.name: Warehouse floor
interiors.detail: The floor is one clear span with dock doors on the east wall and a mezzanine office over the entry. Racking can run the full length without crossing a column line.

properties.title: Camelback Medical Office
properties.description: A two-story medical office on Camelback, leased to a clinic on the ground floor and a specialist suite above. Parking is on grade in front.

interiors.name: Clinic floor
interiors.detail: The ground floor is a clinic: a waiting room at the entry, exam rooms along a single corridor, and a staff door at the back. The upper suite has its own waiting room off the elevator.

properties.title: RiNo Grocery Retail
properties.description: A grocery-anchored retail box in RiNo, with a loading dock at the rear and a sales floor that opens to the street.

interiors.name: Sales floor
interiors.detail: The sales floor is a wide aisle plan with coolers along the back wall and checkout at the street doors. The dock and a small office sit behind the cooler line.

properties.title: East End Industrial
properties.description: A commercial industrial building east of downtown with grade-level doors, a fenced yard, and power sized for light manufacturing.

interiors.name: Shop floor
interiors.detail: The shop is a clear bay with grade doors on the yard side and a two-story office wing at the street. Restrooms and a break room are in the office wing, not on the shop floor.

properties.title: North Loop Office
properties.description: A brick office building in the North Loop, fully leased to creative tenants. The ground floor is a shared lobby and a small cafe bay.

interiors.name: Typical floor
interiors.detail: Each upper floor is an open plate around a freight elevator and a new passenger cab. Perimeter windows are the original industrial sash, with shades in a ceiling pocket.

properties.title: Hayes Valley Retail
properties.description: A two-level retail shop on a Hayes Valley corner, with display windows on both streets and a stock basement under the sales floor.

interiors.name: Sales floor
interiors.detail: The ground floor is the sales room, with windows on two streets and a stair to a second selling level. Stock and a restroom are in the basement, reached by a separate stair at the back.

properties.title: South End Flex Commercial
properties.description: A flex commercial building in South End with a showroom on the street and warehouse bays behind it, split between two tenants.

interiors.name: Showroom
interiors.detail: The street bay is a showroom with a glass storefront and a small office. Two warehouse bays sit behind it, each with a grade door to the truck court.

properties.title: Arts District Commercial Hotel
properties.description: A 48-key commercial hotel in the Arts District, with a lobby restaurant and a small meeting room. The offering opens after the current renovation punch list.

interiors.name: Lobby
interiors.detail: The lobby is a double-height room with the restaurant open to one side and the front desk on the other. Guest rooms are stacked above, and the meeting room is off the restaurant.

comps.address: 700 S Santa Fe Ave, Los Angeles, CA

governance.title: Approve a $180,000 lobby renovation
governance.summary: Replace the lobby stone, lighting, and entry doors. The reserve covers the work. Work would start next quarter and should not pause rent.

governance.title: Appoint Harbor & Co. as property manager
governance.summary: The current manager’s contract ends this year. Harbor & Co. bid a lower fee and a 3-year term with quarterly reporting to shareholders.

governance.title: Authorize a sale above $2.1 million
governance.summary: Allow the board to accept a bona fide bid at or above $2.1 million. A lower bid would come back to shareholders.

governance.title: Fund the outdoor seating expansion
governance.summary: Spend $42,000 from reserves on the patio the tenant requested. The lease amendment raises rent by 4% when the patio opens.

governance.title: Special assessment for seawall repair
governance.summary: Levy $1,200 per share for emergency seawall work. Insurance denied the claim. The work is already quoted.

failures.error: Admins do not buy or sell tokens.
